name: io.github.MerchantGuard/agentguard
title: AgentGuard
description: Local spend caps, kill-switch blocking and Ed25519-signed receipts for AI agent tool calls.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_MCP_DAILY_CAP_CENTS
environmentVariables.description: Local daily spend cap in cents. A nonnegative integer.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_MCP_PER_CALL_CAP_CENTS
environmentVariables.description: Local per-call spend cap in cents. A nonnegative integer.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_MCP_TENANT
environmentVariables.description: Tenant identifier stamped into local receipts.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Local signing-key, configuration and ledger directory. Defaults to .agentguard in the operating system home directory.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_MCP_LEDGER
environmentVariables.description: Local decision storage. ndjson persists receipts across restarts; memory retains this process only.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_MCP_DISABLE_COST_OVERRIDE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to discard and prevent model pricing overrides for this server.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_LOCK_COST_OVERRIDES
environmentVariables.description: Spend SDK startup lock. Set to 1 to prevent model pricing overrides.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_ACTOR_DIGEST
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to hash actor identifiers before they enter local receipts.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_LICENSE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional AgentGuard license key for license validation and seat registration. Otherwise read from local configuration.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_LICENSE_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: License and seat service base URL. No prompts, tool content or receipts are sent.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_NO_BEACON
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to disable optional activation telemetry regardless of saved consent.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to opt in to content-free activation telemetry. Otherwise saved consent applies, default off.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_INSTALL_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional identifier used only by opted-in activation telemetry when no saved install identifier exists.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTGUARD_ANONYMOUS_INSTALL_ID
environmentVariables.description: Legacy fallback for AGENTGUARD_INSTALL_ID in opted-in activation telemetry.

environmentVariables.name: CI
environmentVariables.description: Existing runtime marker. A nonempty value marks opted-in activation telemetry as CI; it does not enable telemetry.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_ACTIONS
environmentVariables.description: Existing runtime marker. A nonempty value marks opted-in activation telemetry as CI; it does not enable telemetry.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_CI
environmentVariables.description: Existing runtime marker. A nonempty value marks opted-in activation telemetry as CI; it does not enable telemetry.

environmentVariables.name: CIRCLECI
environmentVariables.description: Existing runtime marker. A nonempty value marks opted-in activation telemetry as CI; it does not enable telemetry.

environmentVariables.name: BUILDKITE
environmentVariables.description: Existing runtime marker. A nonempty value marks opted-in activation telemetry as CI; it does not enable telemetry.

environmentVariables.name: VERCEL
environmentVariables.description: Existing runtime marker. A nonempty value marks opted-in activation telemetry as CI; it does not enable telemetry.

environmentVariables.name: NETLIFY
environmentVariables.description: Existing runtime marker. A nonempty value marks opted-in activation telemetry as CI; it does not enable telemetry.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.description: Local spend caps, kill-switch blocking and Ed25519-signed receipts for AI agent tool calls. Runs on the developer's machine. Zero data plane: prompts and tool calls never pass through this server.
